title: Code faults that the 27 Nov 2026 docs audit found, syncz's delete pass first
objective: Fix each fault in the code that cc's audit of its docs found on 27 Nov 2026, or close it with a reason. The first is syncz's --confirm --delete pass, which can overwrite newer destination files with no backup: high, and parked with a warning (hv decision 73).
context:
cc's audit of its docs against the code at 6122bae0 (27 Nov 2026, hv decisions 21 and 72) found these faults in the code. hv decision 72 stopped new work, so no code changed. hv decision 73 parked the syncz delete pass, with a warning. "Read" means read in the code and not run.

### High

1. syncz: `--confirm --delete`, answered Y and then Y, runs execute_delete (opt/syncz/syncz around 411-418 and 1261-1266). That is `rsync -rlptD --delete` with no `--update`, `--ignore-existing` or `--backup`. It overwrites every destination file that differs from the source, newer ones too, and makes no `.syncz-bak` copy. help/syncz.md says newer wins, that `--dest-wins` never overwrites, and that `--backup` keeps a copy. No test covers this path. Read, not run.

### arngz

2. A `discover` sent during an apply is not refused. Only apply is scheduled (opt/arngz/lib/arngz.lua 2811), so the discover runs between the apply's phases, and its visit step can show other desktops while the apply works. help/arngz.md now says not to do it.
3. A second `apply` refused because one runs makes its own start, running and end marks in the one "mark" toast slot (opt/arngz/arngz 2417; toast.lua 581). Its end sound and `arngz: stopped: refused` come while the first apply still has the pointer, and the first then shows no mark until it ends. help/arngz.md now says so.
4. P.create_failure (plan.lua around 2243-2246) still says "the Dock did not open Mission Control" on macOS 27, where mc.lua looks in WindowManager first. Comments at arngz.lua 607 and plan.lua 2222-2223 still name `utilz use dev` and hs.spaces' poll.
5. arngz.yaml's purpose lines for hs and Hammerspoon say "needed by arngz apply and discover". help/arngz.md lists more verbs (diff, which, auto, doctor's IPC check), and `utilz doctor` prints the yaml's words.

### cleanz

6. The blank-line squeeze (opt/cleanz/cleanz 152) removes blank lines three at a time, so a run of n blank lines keeps n mod 3: runs of 3 and 6 become 0 and join two paragraphs. help/cleanz.md says at most 2 are kept. Measured by the auditor on sample text with BSD and GNU sed. No test covers it.
7. The AI-metadata match (cleanz 536) is a case-blind substring list: `ai` matches any line with those two letters (eg ThumbnailOffset), and `dalle` misses "DALL-E".
8. In image mode, exiftool's stderr goes to /dev/null under `set -e` (cleanz 568, 572), so a failure exits with exiftool's status and prints nothing.

### lnrel

9. When a directory, or a link to one, is at the link name, `ln -s` makes the link inside it, with a relative path computed for the parent (lnrel 154-162), and lnrel exits 0. help/lnrel.md says lnrel refuses. Read, not run.

### stampz

10. `--date`, `--colour` and `--opacity` are not checked (stampz 400-404) and go into the stamp PDF as given. A value flag at the end with no value, eg `--out`, exits 1 with no message (`shift 2` under `set -e`).
11. A recipient outside WinAnsi gets the right message (stampz 135-139), then also "could not size every one of its N pages" (490-492), which is the wrong reason.

### syncz, more

12. A dry run discards rsync's and unison's exit codes (syncz 272, 325, 635 `|| true`), then reports "0 to transfer" or "Already in sync." and exits 0.
13. The rsync bidi path never reads `--just-do-it` (execute_bidi, syncz 991-1044).
14. The header printed before the `--just-do-it` prompt does not check SYNCZ_ROOTS_SHOWN (syncz 719-728).

### Outside cc's docs (other seats' files, for their owners)

15. Every help/U.md and opt/U/README.md says "**Version**: run `U --version`". Since issue I4cbec17, line 1 of that answer is Utilz's version under U's name, and U's own version is on line 2. A reader of line 1 takes Utilz's version for U's. The templates (opt/utilz/tmpl/help.tmpl:3, README.tmpl:3) make the same line. A change needs every seat's files and the common_lib.bats version-prose test, so cc left it.
16. opt/utilz/tmpl/help.tmpl:63 makes the Environment row "`UTILZ_HOME` - Root directory of Utilz framework", which cc cut from its nine help files: the dispatcher ignores an exported UTILZ_HOME.
17. opt/utilz/tmpl/test.tmpl:22 expects `--version` output to hold "v". Nothing prints a `v` prefix now; the check passes only because a dev tree's line holds "dev".
18. help/utilz.md:139 says no utility binds `-v`; cleanz and syncz bind it as `--verbose`. help/utilz.md:189 says every utility must carry an `integration:` block, but a missing block is an info line only. docs/developer-guide.md:294 names a `prompts` field that no code reads. opt/todo/todo.yaml:32-38 keeps a stale comment that `C-u` fails with todo.
